en.title: GS1 AI Decision Tree
en.s_start: Start: New GS1 Application Identifier (AI) business requirement
en.q_d1: Is the data for use in an open/unrestricted environment?
en.q_d2: Is the data expected to be scanned/read from an AIDC data carrier on a physical entity?
en.q_d3: Is this data in an accessible online database or location?
en.p_a4: ASSESS: How can a share standard (GS1 or other) be used or updated/extended to support the request?
en.p_a4a: DETERMINE: Blockers for share standard adoption + industry investment analysis.
en.q_d5: Would industry support a change to current processes/practices that enables adoption of a share standard?
en.q_d6: Does the AI data enable a complete action or decision WITHOUT further data being retrieved?
en.q_d7: Is the AI data expected to encode a list of details that has no natural upper limit?
en.q_d8: Does the requested AI duplicate (exactly or similarly) an existing AI?
en.q_d9: Is the AI data expected to express a country-specific code value?
en.q_d10: Is the AI data for a LIMITED number of country-specific codes (exception for migration)?
en.q_d11: Is the new AI explicitly required as encoded AIDC data for regulatory compliance and/or operational processes?
en.r_cA: CONCLUSION A: No need for a globally standardised AI. Use closed/restricted mechanisms (e.g., AI (90), AIs (91)-(99), or non-GS1 extensions) as appropriate.
en.r_cB: CONCLUSION B: Use a share standard for data exchange/retrieval (possibly update/extend it, and/or support adoption with training/tools).
en.r_cC: CONCLUSION C: Use an existing AI (e.g., SI unit-based AI) and apply software unit conversions / avoid duplication.
en.r_cD: CONCLUSION D: Create a new GS1 Application Identifier per SOP and business rules; conserve key space and prefer existing value formats where possible.
